column1: # mkexpect.py --reasons for our driver: REGEX<tab>why, first match wins

column2: fragment_ops random/interaction: two-sided stencil (the 27-dword block DMA, +45) and blends with SUBTRACT on one side and REVERSE_SUBTRACT on the other (dropped until um-re 29f5a4c, +144) fixed; the rest order-dependent

cube maps: NPOT faces (no cube layout for them: the DDK samples one linear face and fails every one), and faces of 8/16-bit formats with mip chains and chains sampled without mipmapping (fixed on the cube-wip branch: faces on 0x800 bytes, a level-0 copy; not yet run on hardware)
texture uploads: unpack alignment, sub-image updates and copies of 16-bit formats; the DDK fails teximage2d_align too
texture sampling: LOD bias and completeness corner cases
render to texture: shared and recreated colour buffers, resizes; 565/4444/5551 targets stored as RGBA8; the DDK fails the shared/recreate cases too
compiler: random combinations that fail with F16 off too; with the compiler session
wide lines: the hardware's line quads against GL's rule; the DDK fails these too
points from glDrawElements; the DDK fails these too
GL_MAX_VERTEX_UNIFORM_VECTORS 120: st keeps 8 for clip planes; a 136-vec4 buffer gave 128 but broke dynamic reads of constant arrays (shaders.indexing.tmp_array)
depth and stencil cleared together with no mask or scissor: the stencil comes out 0 (the masked and scissored variants pass)
